records.title: Evaluating the performance of LLM summarization prompts with G-Eval
records.description: Evaluating the performance of summarization prompts is a challenging concept. The normal comparison done by LLMs between the output and a ground truth is not feasible, as the answer is subjective and difficult to compare. One solution, known as G-Eval, uses GPT-4 to evaluate the quality of summaries without a ground truth. It performs evaluation across four dimensions: fluency, coherence, consistency, relevance; it then outputs numeric results, allowing for objective comparison between prompt iterations, and a cohesive and scientific experimentation process.

valueScore.rationale: G-Eval 给出无唯一参考答案时的模型裁判评估方法，对生成质量评测很重要。

records.title: A list of metrics for evaluating LLM-generated content
records.description: Evaluating the performance of machine learning models is crucial for determining their effectiveness and reliability. To do that, quantitative measurement with reference to ground truth output (also known as evaluation metrics) are needed. However, LLM applications are a recent and fast evolving ML field, where model evaluation is not straightforward and there is no unified approach to measure LLM performance. Several metrics have been proposed in the literature for evaluating the performance of LLMs. It is essential to use the right metrics that are suitable for the problem we are attempting to solve.

valueScore.rationale: 评测指标清单覆盖多个 LLM 质量维度，适用广但可被更权威专题资料部分替代。

records.title: What is a Translator custom dictionary?
records.description: How to create an aligned document that specifies a list of phrases or sentences (and their translations) that you always want Microsoft Translator to translate the same way. Dictionaries are sometimes also called glossaries or term bases.

valueScore.rationale: 术语表强制固定短语翻译，是专业领域一致性的核心控制机制。

records.description: This article is a guide to document formats, naming conventions, and how to avoid naming conflicts for Custom Translator.

records.title: Custom Translator training and modeling?
records.description: A model is the system, which provides translation for a specific language pair. The outcome of a successful training is a model. To train a model, three mutually exclusive data sets are required training dataset, tuning dataset, and testing dataset.

valueScore.rationale: 训练、调优和测试集分离是定制翻译建模与可靠评估的核心。

records.reason: 价值评分 9/10；通过总分与知识重要性双重门槛。
records.title: What are Custom Translator parallel documents?
records.description: Parallel documents are paired documents where one is the translation of the other. One document in the pair contains sentences in the source language and the other document contains these sentences translated into the target language.

valueScore.rationale: 平行文档是监督式机器翻译的关键数据结构，具有稳定基础价值。

records.reason: 价值评分 9/10；通过总分与知识重要性双重门槛。
records.title: Sentence pairing and alignment in parallel documents
records.description: During the training execution, sentences present in parallel documents are paired or aligned. Custom Translator learns translations one sentence at a time, by reading a sentence and translating it. Then it aligns words and phrases in these two sentences to each other.

valueScore.rationale: 句对齐和词语对齐决定平行语料能否转化为有效翻译监督信号。
